audit.summary: Application CI failed: five jobs passed; Windows CTest recorded 153 passed entries, two failures and two optional FFmpeg skips. The green-CI milestone remains unmet.
details: All six existing jobs ran on the exact PR 15 merge without a CI skip marker. Public text relay, Linux journal persistence, Windows operator paths, PowerShell 5.1 and offline Discord voice jobs passed. The native all-target build, controlled-loopback conversation relay and GNU ld relink checks passed; the CTest step failed.

All 157 expected registrations matched discovery. CTest recorded 153 successful entries, two failed entries and two SKIP_RETURN_CODE=77 entries: ReviaVideoDecoderTests and Revia.VideoPreview lacked optional FFmpeg/ffprobe prerequisites. The native frameworks additionally reported 21 optional subcheck skips: one VTube Studio, three torch-policy, fourteen Pillow and three real training/export/evaluation smokes. Public text relay skipped one Windows-only case; the separate Windows operator job passed its five cases. Skips are not passes or proof of those optional capabilities.

ReviaAudiencePrivacyTests failed while opening its complete PNG after the fixture changed the working directory. Relative source paths under the CI ccache configuration are the leading explanation, not a newly observed privacy disclosure. Revia.InteractiveBrowser failed its stale-target attempted-status assertion: native accounting treats a dispatched mutation as attempted even when stale generation is rejected. The compound assertion does not establish a second DOM mutation. Both failures, source identities and the original logs are retained; no assertions were weakened and no rerun is claimed.

This CI run tests source 29df918f62c2dbc2eece734122bb583b934512d8. The nine-path delegation candidate and its combined local fixture checks remain unpublished and outside this CI run. The real-model reviewed-report scenario remains unestablished.
